name: deep_50m_sweep
description: Deep three-venue book carrying well over 500 BTC per side, so every notional band up to 50M fills. The intermediate px*qty exceeds int64 by orders of magnitude, so an implementation multiplying scaled price by scaled quantity in int64 produces wrong numbers here and correct ones on any shallow fixture.
notes: Venue ladders deliberately share prices at some levels (binance 0.01 tick vs bybit 0.05 vs okx 0.10) so the merge must SUM at shared prices rather than concatenate.
